spans.s:
Bisa denotes the radical fibres of the lotus, which seem to have been eaten as a delicacy as early as the times of the Atharvaveda. It is mentioned also in the aitareya brāhmaṇa and the aitareya Āraṇyaka.
Foot notes iv. 34, 5.
v. 30.
iii. 2, 4; śāṅkhāyana Āraṇyaka, xi. 4. Cf. Zimmer, Altindisches Leben, 70.
